title: Project Constraints and Dependencies

decision_rules.condition: A required external integration has not been verified.
decision_rules.action: Do not commit to its implementation feasibility; request technical evidence or conduct a feasibility assessment.

decision_rules.condition: A critical migration dependency is inaccessible.
decision_rules.action: Identify affected migration scope and do not claim migration readiness.
Record it as unknown; do not fabricate a delivery estimate.
Prevent the affected gated action from proceeding.

decision_rules.condition: A constraint conflicts with a desired requirement.
decision_rules.action: Document the conflict and propose options without silently discarding either side.

rules: Identify the source and owner of material constraints.
A dependency is not resolved merely because an agent recommends a solution.
Record mitigation plans for material risks.
Escalate time-sensitive blockers to the responsible owner.
